127.1  MAYORAL INITIATIVE

  Mayor Butts:

  INTERIM ORDINANCE NO. 22-05 INTRODUCED AND ADOPTED –
  IMPOSING A TEMPORARY MORATORIUM ON THE ESTABLISHMENT OF
  FURTHER SHORT-TEM RENTAL USE IN THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD AS OF
  JANUARY 1, 2022. Initiative by Mayor James T. Butts, Jr., requesting that the City
  Council enact an uncodified interim ordinance, imposing a temporary moratorium on the
  establishment of further short-term rental use in the City of Inglewood, the prohibition of
  party-houses, and the establishment of a requirement for Host Platforms to immediately
  remit Transient Occupancy Taxes to the City for all Short Term Rentals operated in the
  City as of January 1, 2022.

  3
   February 1, 2022

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council make the following findings: a) There are an increasing number of
  unauthorized short term rentals in the City of Inglewood that has raised significant
  concerns about the loss of permanent housing at a time when the City is suffering from a
  workforce and permanent affordable housing crisis in the area; b) In creating more non-
  permanent housing stock, there are significant concerns around decreasing long-term
  rental opportunities and increasing rents for local residents; c) The City Council finds that
  there is a current and immediate threat to the public health, safety and welfare associated
  with the proliferation of short term rentals and that the approval of additional permits
  authorizing residential units to be used as short term rentals would serve to exacerbate the
  threat during the time that staff introduces, and the City Council reviews and adopts
  proposed amendments to the City’s Municipal Code. The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  Thereupon, Interim Ordinance No. 22-05 entitled:

  AN UNCODIFIED INTERIM ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF  INGLEWOOD
  MORATORIUM ON THE ESTABLISHMENT OF SHORT-TERM  RENTAL USE
  PARTY-HOUSES

  was introduced by Mayor Butts.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Mayor Butts that further
  reading be waived. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  Furthermore, it was moved by Mayor Butts, and seconded by Council Member Morales
  that Interim Ordinance No. 22-05 entitled:

  AN UNCODIFIED INTERIM ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF  INGLEWOOD
  MORATORIUM ON THE ESTABLISHMENT OF SHORT-TERM  RENTAL USE
  PARTY-HOUSES

  be adopted. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.
